result.note: Tested the venue of the February 2026 India–Israel defence MoU and the background of bilateral ties; skipped the expected Modi visit as it is only planned.

questions.prompt: In February 2026, India and Israel signed a defence Memorandum of Understanding meant to institutionalise cooperation between their private companies in weapons development. In which city was it signed?
questions.explain: The MoU was signed in Tel Aviv on 19 February 2026, alongside a seminar involving 30 Indian and 26 Israeli firms. It signals a shift from buying and selling towards joint ventures and co-development under India's Make in India policy.
questions.source: India and Israel signed a defence Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in Tel Aviv on Thursday, a move designed to institutionalise cooperation between their private companies in weapons development.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India–Israel relations:
items: India and Israel established full ties in 1992.
India originally turned to Israel for arms to diversify away from its heavy dependence on Russian arms.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements are correct: full ties date to 1992, and India first looked to Israel to reduce its reliance on Russian weapons. Israel, in turn, found a large and reliable customer for its high-tech sensors and drones.
questions.source: Since establishing full ties in 1992, defence has been the bedrock of the relationship.
